Trust attaches to a finished task, not to an address, so a clone that never finishes anything holds nothing. A farm has to buy distinct residential exits per seat and keep each one answering, which turns the tide against bulk registration. The cedar of a long-lived identity is paid for by work, and the plume of a fresh clone earns nothing until it does some.
